notes: Than va dau la hai khoi tron lon nhat nen chia moi khoi 4 mui qua tam (trai/phai x truoc/sau); tach mat den thanh decal truoc khi chia dau de duong cat khong di qua mat; de tron chia 4 cung. Cac khoi nho (tay, chan, but chi, tay sach, buc tuong, tao, chan ban, mu trum) da la khoi rieng tu Tripo nen giu nguyen.
